mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_agent_submission(actor,operation,external_key,request_hash) VALUES(#{actor},#{operation},#{key},#{hash}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id=id
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash AS requestHash,resource_id AS resourceId FROM kb_agent_submission WHERE actor=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND external_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_agent_submission SET resource_id=#{resourceId} WHERE actor=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND external_key=#{key} AND resource_id IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT resource_id FROM kb_agent_submission WHERE actor=#{actor} AND operation=#{operation} AND external_key=#{key}
